author: Splades
body:
Kit/Class Name: Troll
Game Name: Control The Hill
Items: Iron sword(Durable), full leather except helmet(chain)
Level: 35
Abilities (if any): Slowness I

What makes this kit unique?
This kit is unique because if it gets accepted it will be the only kit that will be awarded at level 35. It is also unique because it is the only kit with slowness (other than scout but scout needs to be fixed). It is also a high level kit so players will need to work hard to earn it. This kit is less overpowered than knight because knight has a diamond helmet along with a better sword, also knight has no slowness. This is why I think level 35 is an suitable level to be awarded this kit.
